description: A daily measure on a line chart hides the question that matters: why was that Tuesday so good? The answer is usually on the calendar — a promotion, a campaign, a public holiday — and it lives in another report. Calendar Events Heatmap puts both in one place. Each day is coloured by your measure, and the events that explain it sit on the day they happened. Click a day, or drag across a week, and the whole report filters to it. WHAT IS NEW IN 1.2 • Year, month and week views, with drill up and down and a Today button • Drag across days to filter the report by a date range • Fiscal calendars that follow your year: by month, or in 4-4-5, 4-5-4 and 5-4-4 weeks • Color rules: paint the days above or below your thresholds • Ten colour schemes, two of them colour-blind safe, and five style templates • Events as colour marks in five clearly distinct palettes, so the heatmap stays readable; the legend names each colour • A setup guide inside the visual, format on the canvas, and twelve languages A CALENDAR THAT READS LIKE A HEATMAP • Every day coloured by the measure, with a legend for the scale • Promotions, campaigns or incidents on their day, one colour per category • Public holidays marked, with their name in the tooltip • ISO or US week numbers; weeks starting on Monday or Sunday • Tooltips with every measure you add, and report tooltip pages FISCAL YEARS AS YOUR BUSINESS COUNTS…
